NLPeer_ARR: consented release objects only; never infer non-consenting records
Re2: derived initial-version/rebuttal-turn assertions requiring source-note verification
ResearchArcade: candidate revision/link candidates and graph convenience fields
ReviewArena: OCR-derived markdown only, subject to manuscript-level rights
legacy_local_P2: existing exploratory outcomes and novelty/rating transforms

reviewarena_iclr.finding: row-level overlap is measured without retaining manuscript/review text

method: Hugging Face Dataset Viewer metadata APIs and Parquet column-range reads; no corpus text retained

release_policy.coverage: no derived corpus establishes OpenReview candidate-pool completeness
release_policy.identifiers_and_counts: retain with dataset citation and retrieval snapshot
release_policy.identity: no reviewer profiling or deanonymization; ResearchArcade writer strings are not identity truth
release_policy.raw_text: do not duplicate; retain source pointer/hash unless affirmative object licence is verified

scope_decision: Public Viewer metadata and identifier columns are reconciled where free and licence-safe. NLPeer/MOPRD remain manifest-only because the no-bespoke-partnership and object-licence gates forbid a request-only or unresolved pull.
unresolved: Re2 viewer has splits but no materialized viewer size; use release manifest/paper until files are auditable
PeerRead requires legacy loading code and is not supported by Dataset Viewer
NLPeer data requires its documented request/licence workflow and is not silently acquired
MOPRD public distribution and object licences remain unresolved; registry/paper counts only
Review Arcade lacks stable OpenReview IDs in its viewer schema, so title-only overlap is not forced
